verdicts.explanation: All nine noindexed pages sit under /rewards/, the internal staff-pay-and-benefits section for MSF employees, in three languages; general-public pages like the homepage and who-we-are stay indexable.
contact-us is a directory that routes visitors to their nearest of many regional MSF offices rather than a single head-office contact page, so it does not itself owe one phone or email.

Both about-offices and donation-plans are real, live content pages a mobile visitor can land on directly, so the missing viewport tag is a genuine mobile-usability defect, not a test or placeholder artifact.

The finding's own evidence shows this affects a handful of controls out of hundreds per page (12/253 on the homepage, 4/418 on who-we-are, 4/229 on the staff-rewards page), on large, richly-linked pages, not a widespread pattern.

candidate_dispositions.claim_title: /donation-plans shows its donation plans only inside a third-party iframe

candidate_dispositions.reason: donation-plans uses 'MSF', the organisation's own well-known abbreviation for 'Medecins Sans Frontieres (MSF) International' used on the homepage, not a different or ambiguous brand name.

claims.title: /donation-plans shows its donation plans only inside a third-party iframe
claims.why: The page's own text is just nine words ('Donation Plans See our plans above.'); the actual plan names and amounts live inside an embedded payments.thirdparty-msf.example iframe, which a non-rendering fetcher never opens, so an assistant summarizing donation options from this page has nothing to quote.

suggested_action.summary: Render the donation plan names and amounts as HTML text on /donation-plans, alongside the payment iframe.
how: Add a static list of each donation plan's name and monthly amount above or beside the iframe.
Keep the iframe only for the interactive payment step.
suggested_action.verify: Fetch https://www.msf.org/donation-plans without executing JavaScript and confirm the plan names and amounts appear in the HTML body.

site_specific: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to the <head> of the donation-plans template.
Apply the same tag to about-offices, since it shares the defect.
